filter: judgment categories only; numeric/threshold titles removed; lifetime>=7d; one market per event
independence_warning: Rows are one-per-event by construction, so market-level clustering is unnecessary here; if within-event rows are ever re-added, cluster on event_ticker (docs/10 2026-08-27l).
text_removed_note: Question titles are the venue's content, not ours, and are not redistributed here (see DATASHEET.md, Distribution). Rows are keyed by question_id, which is the venue's own stable id -- the text is retrievable from the venue's public API by that id, subject to the venue's terms. verify.py joins on question_id and never reads text, so every number in the model card remains reproducible from this file. `content_hash` is over the question_id list and is reproducible from this file; `content_hash_with_text`, where present, is the original hash which also covered the removed titles.
